title: The gap closed again, but North Carolina needs to wake up
summary: Almost a million more early ballots came in overnight and the Democratic lead in the hard counts shrank again. But North Carolina's first day of in-person voting should worry every Republican in the state.

title: Georgia showed up, Michigan is a coin flip, and the gap is closing
summary: Georgia went from 5,538 early votes to almost 381,000 in one pull. Michigan's early vote gap is down to about half a point. Here's what the numbers actually say.

title: Why I built this site, and why you need to vote early
summary: My research kept disappearing into 60-second videos, so now the receipts have a home. First up: early voting, because that's how we won in 2024.
